note: Village of Greenport park (North Fork). Transient and seasonal stays; reservation requests open to non-residents. --Claude
summary: Confirmed fees ($63 daily / $86 holiday trailers, $400 weekly; no non-resident rate and no minimum stay posted), reservations by request form, showers and dump. Changed hookups water/sewer true -> no hookups at all: the village's 2026 map is headed 'TENTS • RVS • DRY CAMPING ONLY'. Cleared the derived 40-site count (the map numbers 35 RV-field sites, 14 tent sites, 4 F sites, no total). Season not stated (monthly rates run May-October). Note's hookup claim removed as contradicted.
flags: Possible mostly-seasonal park: the fee schedule sells a $4,850 Season and monthly rates ($800 May/Oct, $865 Jun-Sep) beside the $63 daily rate, and the 2026 map labels only site 31 'TRANSIENT' among the 35 RV-field sites (https://villageofgreenport.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Campground_Rules_Fees_and_Map-v7-6-25-2026.pdf). A daily rate and a public request form exist, but how many RV sites are open to overnight visitors is not stated.
Inclusion evidence says 'water/electric + full hookup RV sites', but the village's 2026 map says 'DRY CAMPING ONLY'; worth a look at whether the inclusion read was of an older page.
